text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, as I was walking 
toward the school building while yawning, 
I bumped into Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. I'll be taking 
first place arriving at school today, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
An honor student's foundation is early to 
bed, early to rise. I slept soundly last 
night, and my skin feels perfect.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Look at you, yawning like that by 
comparison. Don't tell me you stayed up 
late?"
choice_data_list:
I was putting together a training plan 
and...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Go to bed early tonight! If you collapse, 
I'm the one who's gonna be in trouble!
